domains.name: Concord
domains.purpose: Product-wide Concord law and architecture: constitutional constraints, development authority, and decisions that bind every child Domain rather than any single one.

domains.name: Durable authority
domains.purpose: Owns the durable state envelope: the SQLite authority with current rows and finite snapshots (CD-0242 D2), typed projections, migrations, and the transactional guarantees that make an acknowledged write durable.

domains.name: Workflow engine
domains.purpose: Owns work lifecycle: workflow types and their contracts, workflow actions and transitions, completion predicates and verdicts, evidence binding, architecture overlap resolution, and terminal-state law.

domains.name: Agent surface
domains.purpose: Owns the composition and concordance of the agent contract, call authority, adapter, worker-lane, and evolution boundaries. It keeps cross-surface architecture together without owning its children's behavior.

domains.name: Agent contract
domains.purpose: Owns agent jobs, tool granularity, read and mutation intents, operation declarations, and schema-driven payload admission. It defines the callable contract without owning call authority or host transport.

domains.name: Agent call boundary
domains.purpose: Owns call scope, authorization, idempotency, result and error semantics, evidence references, and pagination. It admits calls and reports their effects without owning the operation inventory or host session movement.

domains.name: Agent adapter
domains.purpose: Owns OpenCode registration, host context and session placement, the permission bridge, CLI transport, and host-owned wait delivery. It carries the canonical surface without acquiring core call or workflow authority.

domains.name: Worker lanes
domains.purpose: Owns typed lane contracts, dispatch identity, worker evidence and visibility, portable lane methods, and the boundary around host-owned worker execution. It does not own workflow state or host-specific procedure.

domains.name: Agent evolution
domains.purpose: Owns generated manifest identity, pre-go-live agent-surface changes, and deterministic change evidence. It binds core and adapter artifacts to one contract without creating a separate callable surface.

domains.name: Product memory and law
domains.purpose: Owns Product knowledge: the knowledge index and its records, the Domain registry as law, law-coverage and conformance records, lessons and research, and compaction and retention policy.

domains.name: Work coordination
domains.purpose: Owns the work item as an entity: its declared attributes and urgency, provenance, the typed relation vocabulary between work items, durable inter-agent resource claims, work-addressed peer messages, and non-authoritative mid-execution observations. It owns what a work item means and how work items refer to one another, not how work executes and not how it persists.

domains.name: Operator surface
domains.purpose: Owns the human-facing plane: the terminal launcher, the CLI verb surface and its operator diagnostics, installation and release packaging, and the navigation path an operator uses to reach Product state.

domains.name: Repository verification
domains.purpose: Owns the authority a repository check may hold: what a validator may assert, what it may block, how required checks bind to declared coverage, and the boundary between a check's finding and accepted Product law.
